text: Oh! A new face. Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild of Highmourn!
I'm Elowen. Registrations, requests, rewards and rank evaluations all go through me. Are you here to sign up?
The people of Highmourn bring us their troubles: the dead that won't stay buried, beasts on the roads, crypts that need clearing. We post them on the board as requests.
Adventurers take them, do the job, and come back to me for the reward. Simple, isn't it? Well... the coming back part isn't always.
Everyone starts at F rank. No exceptions, not even for heroes from far away.
Finish requests to earn Guild Points. When you have enough, come back to me for an evaluation and I'll raise your rank. Shall I write you in?
There! {player}, F-rank adventurer of the Guild.
Here's your guild card. Please don't lose it, the replacement fee is outrageous. The board is open to you whenever you're ready.
Welcome back, {player}! What can the Guild do for you today?
{player}! I was hoping you'd come by. You've earned enough points for a rank evaluation.
Congratulations! As of today, you are a {rank}-rank adventurer.
Harder requests are open to you now, and the pay's better too. Just... be careful out there, all right?
Your next evaluation needs {next}. Keep at it, I have high hopes for you.
SSS rank... In all my years at this desk I never thought I'd write that on someone's card.
There's nothing higher I can give you. Only the stories they'll tell about you.
F, E, D, C, B, A, and then S. Beyond S there's SS, and SSS, the stuff of legends. Only a handful have ever made SSS.
You can take requests of your own rank, or one above it if you're feeling brave. Three at a time, and please report back when they're done.
